findings.title: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) in /total_loan_payments endpoint
findings.description: The /total_loan_payments endpoint is vulnerable to Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) via the 'principal' parameter. User input is passed directly into a Jinja2 template that builds JSON objects, allowing arbitrary Python code execution through lipsum.__globals__.os.popen().

reproduction.expected: Response contains loan_principal value of 49, confirming template expression evaluation
